patch_description: Replace the empty stub with a deterministic constructor that (1) builds a good symmetric starting arrangement of 11 points in the unit equilateral triangle, and (2) runs a short, seeded local optimization that maximizes a soft-min (log-sum-exp) surrogate of the minimum triangle area, with clipping back into the triangle after each perturbation. The soft-min surrogate gives a smooth objective whose maximization pushes up the true minimum area (all 165 triplets are considered). A small fixed iteration budget keeps eval_time low while determinism is preserved via np.random.default_rng(0). On any failure we fall back to the initial symmetric arrangement, satisfying the error-handling requirement.
